title: Wright-Patterson as reverse-engineering site for enemy equipment

tellings.quote: Wright Pat was the place that the military would take enemy equipment in order to reverse engineer it.

plain: Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, was where the military took captured enemy equipment in the 1940s to reverse engineer it, meaning to take it apart and work out how it was built, Michels says. He tells this himself, without naming a source, in his interview with David Grusch, a former intelligence officer. The point is that the base was already set up to study foreign hardware, which is why it comes up in UFO stories.
